integrity: Mathematical proof and standalone finite-field verification are supplied; self-review only, no external or independent validation or certification.
scientific_limitations: The census concerns left multiplication by radical elements in length-three truncated cyclic Nakayama algebras, with q a prime power and cycle length at least three. It does not count all nilpotent endomorphisms, classify automorphism orbits, or handle higher truncation orders. Equivalence to an unindexed earlier formula remains a priority risk; extension fields and the n-to-infinity limit are supported by proof rather than exhaustive computation.
title: Complete Jordan census and Gaussian block law for cubic cyclic Nakayama algebras
